history.alreadyCancelled: The selected sales have already been cancelled; they cannot be cancelled again.
history.alreadyHidden: The selected sales have already been removed from the list.
history.alreadyListed: The selected sales are already in the list.
history.alreadyCancelledShort: The selected sales have already been cancelled
history.incompleteTitle: Sales history loaded incompletely — partial list
history.totalsNote: Cancelled sales are not included in net totals. Sales removed from the list remain in the totals because they were not cancelled{hidden}.
history.cancelTitle: Cancels the sale; quantities of products still in stock are added back
history.hideTitle: Removes from the visible list only; stock does not change
history.onlyHide: {reason}; only “Remove from List” can be used.
history.archiveNote: Sales removed from the list. Restoring them does not change stock or sale status.
history.emptyArchive: No sales removed from the list.
history.otherCategory: + {count} product(s) from another category (actions apply to the whole sale)
